# Public Land Lovers

> Public Land Lovers documents public lands across the American West through
> original GIS mapping, field-based articles, and van life travel — run by
> Andrew Johnson and Janyne Little of Orovada Consulting LLC.

## Threats to Public Lands
- [Threats to Public Lands](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/): Hub tracking the biggest current threats to U.S. public lands, place by place.
- [Big Bend Border Wall](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/big-bend-border-wall/): Proposed border infrastructure through Big Bend National Park and Big Bend Ranch State Park.
- [Bears Ears](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/bears-ears/): Ongoing fight over Bears Ears National Monument's boundaries and protections.
- [Grand Staircase-Escalante](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/grand-staircase-escalante/): Threats to Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument.
- [Roadless Rule](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/roadless-rule/): What repealing the Roadless Rule means for national forest land.
- [Chaco Canyon](https://publiclandlovers.com/public-land-threats/chaco-canyon/): Drilling and development pressure near Chaco Culture National Historical Park.

## Maps
- [Maps](https://publiclandlovers.com/maps/): Interactive maps built with ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online from original fieldwork.

## Articles
- [Articles](https://publiclandlovers.com/articles/): Original field notes and public lands advocacy writing.

## About
- [About](https://publiclandlovers.com/about/): About Public Land Lovers and Orovada Consulting LLC.
- [Work With Us](https://publiclandlovers.com/work-with-us/): GIS, geospatial, and environmental consulting services from Orovada Consulting LLC.
